instruction: Apply only the supplied policy guidance. Do not invent missing project authority. Classify every case independently and return exactly one row per listed case in the same order; never omit tail cases. Disposition classifies the stated claim or requested operation: block an unsafe or invariant-violating claim, use unavailable only when no unsafe claim is made and a required input cannot be obtained, use idempotent only for expected already-applied bytes, and otherwise allow. When requested deterministic recovery or writeback is policy-blocked, report the blocked write action rather than encoding it as no action. Preserve valid decision inventories and authority rows when a later audit, patch or final-owner defect blocks reconciliation.
